text:
I couldn't set the discount for P-1017. It is still 0%, and I did not click Apply discount.

The "Set discount" link on the P-1017 row opens a panel with a 0%–60% slider, an "Apply discount" button and a "Cancel" button. I tried clicking the slider, pressing arrow, Home, End and Tab keys, and dragging it. None of that moved it: the label stayed at "Discount for P-1017: 0%". The browser tool doesn't expose the slider handle as an element I can control.

The panel for P-1017 is still open. No other product's discount was changed.
